purpose: Catch false positives, silent identity changes, overblocking, source substitution, and scope drift.
required_behavior: A resolving DOI with a metadata mismatch escalates; it never silently replaces the source record.
Similarity never confirms identity or authorizes a merge.
An inaccessible URL is not treated as a missing source when identity evidence exists.
Personal communications and approved further-reading exceptions are not falsely reported as orphan or missing-reference defects.
Claim support is routed to Scholarly/Editorial Integrity rather than decided by RCI.
